nodes.name: Export Callback
nodes.notes: AI-Ark's Export People with Email endpoint refuses a request without an HTTPS webhook; Waterfall Contacts Batch submits every export with this door (plus ?run=<parent execution id>). Answers 200 on receipt, then records the call: the ark pass reads the data table for its track ids instead of polling statistics per export (ruled 2026-09-02).

nodes.name: Store Callback
nodes.notes: Upsert on trackId, never update-only: a DONE webhook can land before the submitter recorded anything, and the row must exist either way. Data table ai_ark_callbacks (id PYw0JjF0o7FLmaPw; columns trackId string, state string, found number, total number, run string, receivedAt string, payload string), created by the Operator 2026-09-02.
